fullPassage: From an organizational viewpoint, one of the most fascinating examples of how any organization may contain many different types of culture is to recognize the functional operations of different departments within the organization. The varying departments and divisions within an organization will inevitably view any given situation from their own biased and prejudiced perspective. A department and its members will acquire "tunnel vision" which disallows them to see things as others see them. The very structure of organizations can create conflict. The choice of whether the structure is "mechanistic" or "organic" can have a profound influence on conflict management. A mechanistic structure has a vertical hierarchy with many rules, many procedures, and many levels of management involved in decision making. Organic structures are more horizontal in nature, where decision making is less centralized and spread across the plane of the organization.

❌ ④ gathered: gathered(모인)는 집중과 유사해 반의어가 아님
det.tip: centralized(중앙집권화된) ↔ decentralized(분권화된). concentrated·unified는 유사어

questions.passage:
(A) The pilot landed the <u>plane</u> safely at the airport despite the heavy storm over the ocean.
(B) Decision making is less centralized and spread across the <u>plane</u> of the organization.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 plane의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: plane: (A) 조종사가 착륙시킨 비행기 / (B) 조직 전반에 펼쳐진 평면/영역
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 비행기 — (B) 평면/영역: (A)는 조종사가 착륙시킨 비행기(명사), (B)는 의사결정이 펼쳐지는 조직의 평면/영역이라는 뜻으로 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 평야 — (B) 평면/영역: (A)의 plane은 조종사가 착륙시킨 비행기이지 평야가 아님
❌ ③ (A) 비행기 — (B) 대패: (B)의 plane은 목공용 대패가 아닌 평면/영역
❌ ④ (A) 수준 — (B) 비행기: (A)는 수준이 아닌 비행기, (B)는 비행기가 아닌 평면/영역
det.tip: plane: ① (명사) 비행기 ② (명사) 평면/영역 ③ (명사) 대패 ④ (형용사) 평평한

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a system in which people or things are arranged in order of rank or importance"

det.korean: hierarchy=위계/계층 (사람이나 사물이 지위·중요도 순으로 배열된 체계)
det.analysis:
❌ ① perspective: perspective(관점)는 보는 시각이지 지위 순 체계가 아님
✅ ② hierarchy: hierarchy(위계/계층)는 사람·사물이 지위나 중요도 순으로 배열된 체계로 영영 정의와 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ conflict: conflict(갈등)는 대립이지 순위 체계가 아님
❌ ④ procedure: procedure(절차)는 일하는 순서이지 지위 순 체계가 아님
det.tip: hierarchy = 위계/계층. arranged in order of rank(지위 순으로 배열)가 핵심

questions.passage: The varying departments and divisions within an organization will __________ (inevitable) view any given situation from their own biased and prejudiced perspective. A department and its members will acquire "tunnel vision" which disallows them to see things as others see them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'will __________ view'에서 조동사 will과 동사 view 사이에서 동사 view를 수식하는 자리이므로, 형용사 inevitable이 아니라 부사 inevitably가 와야 한다. inevitable → inevitably
det.tip: inevitable(형용사) → inevitably(부사). 동사 view를 수식하므로 부사형

questions.passage: The very structure of organizations can create conflict. The choice of whether the structure is "mechanistic" or "organic" can have a __________ (profoundly) influence on conflict management.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'a __________ influence'에서 관사 a와 명사 influence 사이에서 명사를 수식하는 자리이므로, 부사 profoundly가 아니라 형용사 profound가 와야 한다. profoundly → profound
det.tip: profoundly(부사) → profound(형용사). 명사 influence를 수식하므로 형용사형

questions.passage: From an organizational viewpoint, one of the most fascinating examples of how any organization may contain many different types of culture is to recognize the functional operations of different departments within the organization. The varying departments and divisions within an organization will inevitably view any given situation from their own biased and prejudiced perspective. A department and its members will acquire "__________" which disallows them to see things as others see them. The very structure of organizations can create conflict. The choice of whether the structure is "mechanistic" or "organic" can have a profound influence on conflict management. A mechanistic structure has a vertical hierarchy with many rules, many procedures, and many levels of management involved in decision making. Organic structures are more horizontal in nature, where decision making is less centralized and spread across the plane of the organization.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: tunnel vision=터널 시야(좁은 시야) — 다른 사람처럼 보지 못하게 하는 좁은 관점
det.analysis:
❌ ① clear insight(명확한 통찰): 다르게 보지 못하게 한다는 뒤 내용과 반대
❌ ② mutual respect(상호 존중): 좁은 시야와 무관
❌ ③ broad understanding(폭넓은 이해): 'disallows them to see things as others see them'과 반대
✅ ④ tunnel vision(터널 시야/좁은 시야): 부서가 다른 사람처럼 사물을 보지 못하게 하는 좁은 시야를 얻는다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: acquire tunnel vision which disallows them to see things as others see them

questions.passage: From an organizational viewpoint, one of the most fascinating examples of how any organization may contain many different types of culture is to recognize the functional operations of different departments within the organization. The varying departments and divisions within an organization will inevitably view any given situation from their own biased and prejudiced perspective. A department and its members will acquire "tunnel vision" which disallows them to see things as others see them. The very structure of organizations can create conflict. The choice of whether the structure is "mechanistic" or "organic" can have a profound influence on conflict management. A mechanistic structure has a vertical hierarchy with many rules, many procedures, and many levels of management involved in decision making. Organic structures are more horizontal in nature, where decision making is less centralized and __________ the plane of the organization.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: spread across=~전반에 퍼지다 — 유기적 구조에서 의사결정이 조직 전반에 퍼진다
det.analysis:
❌ ① limited to(~로 제한된): 덜 중앙집권화된다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② removed from(~에서 제거된): 의사결정이 조직에서 사라진다는 뜻이 되어 부적절
✅ ③ spread across(~전반에 퍼지다): 유기적 구조에서 의사결정이 덜 중앙집권화되고 조직 평면 전반에 퍼진다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ hidden within(~안에 숨겨진): 분산되어 퍼진다는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: less centralized and spread across the plane — 덜 중앙집권화되고 전반에 퍼진
